parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hi John.

Hi Wendy. Thanks for coming to discuss the school art competition. I know this is your first year organising it.

Well, I’ve got some ideas but I’d appreciate some help with arrangements.

Okay. We usually divide the competition into age groups. The first age group is junior students.

I’ll just note that down.

Last year we went with a theme of family. That worked very well.

Yes. Something simple is best for young children, I think. How about animals this year?

Sounds good. And for the type of art, last year children in the junior age group created a drawing. Shall we stick with that?

Yes. And for the prize, I heard last year we gave cinema tickets to the winner. Is that right?

Yes. But you know, it might be nice to give the winners tickets to the zoo this time.

Good idea.

Finally, for the senior students we also have to think of a theme. I’ve got a couple of ideas. One is the future.

I’m not quite sure how students might approach that theme. It could be tricky.

My other idea was the city. What do you think?

Good. Students could get some really interesting images with that theme.

And for the type of art, I think a photograph would work well.

Great idea. And as a prize, one of our sponsors is willing to donate a voucher that the winner can spend on travel.

Fantastic. They can find inspiration for their next artworks.

Now let’s discuss some further details of the competition.

Sure. First of all, the deadline for submitting artwork. We want to award the prizes on May the 25th.

Last year we needed a week to judge the winners and finalise arrangements for the awards night. How about if entrants submit their artwork by May the 18th?

Sure. I’ll just note that down. Where should they submit their artworks? At the office?

Actually, there’s more space at the library. So let’s ask students to take their art there.

Okay. In terms of judging the competition, what did you do last year?

We used an excellent local artist. We should try and use her again this year. Her name is Rebecca Leigh.

Okay. Is that L-double-E?

No. It’s L-E-I-G-H.

Right. I guess I should also note down her number so that I can get in contact with her after we finalise the rest of the competition details.

Sure. I’ve got her number here. Are you ready? It’s 0407 625 4633.

Got it. After the judging, where are we going to display the artworks? How about we book the Bridge Street Gallery? It’s a beautiful old building.

It is. So can you go ahead and book it?

Yes. And do you think we should also publish the artworks in the school magazine?

Yes, definitely. I think the winning students would be delighted to see that.

Great. Now in terms of the art exhibition of the students’ work, should we make it a morning event and follow it up with a special lunch or afternoon tea for parents?

I was thinking a late afternoon event might be better so that parents can attend after work. After the exhibition, we could put on a dinner. What do you think?

Yes, that could be nice. Now I want it....

analyses.content: Wendy 建议今年针对初级组（Junior students）使用 animals（动物）作为绘画比赛的主题。
How about animals this year?
不要受 family 干扰，那是去年的主题，Wendy 明确提议今年换成 animals。
But you know, it might be nice to give the winners tickets to the zoo this time.
录音中提到了 cinema（电影院），但那是去年的奖品，今年被 John 明确否定并更正为 zoo。
John 提议今年给初级组获胜者的奖品换成去 zoo（动物园）的门票。
My other idea was the city.
注意排除法，John 先提议了 the future，但被 Wendy 认为太难（tricky）而否决，随后才确定为 the city。
针对高级组（Senior students），双方最终商定以 city（城市）作为摄影比赛的主题。
...one of our sponsors is willing to donate a voucher that the winner can spend on travel.
卷面已印有 voucher（代金券），只需填入其用途 travel，注意不要漏听这个修饰词。
高级组的获胜者将获得一张可以用于 travel（旅行）的代金券。

analyses.content: How about if entrants submit their artwork by May the 18th?
典型的日期干扰，不要误填 May the 25th，那是颁奖礼（award the prizes）的日期。
比赛作品提交的截止日期被定在 18 May（5月18日）。
因为办公区空间不足，参赛作品最终被要求提交到 library（图书馆）。
Actually, there’s more space at the library.
听到 At the office? 时不要急着动笔，录音中紧接着通过 Actually 进行了转折，确定了 library。
No. It’s L-E-I-G-H.
注意拼写陷阱，录音明确提示不是 L-double-E，而是 L-E-I-G-H。
评委的名字是 Rebecca Leigh，录音中给出了具体的字母拼写。
长数字听写需保持专注，注意数字之间的连贯性，确保没有遗漏任何一位数。
录音清晰报出了评委 Rebecca 的联系电话：0407 625 4633。
...and do you think we should also publish the artworks in the school magazine?
虽然先提到了在画廊（Gallery）展示，但第 9 题对应的空位是作品“出现（appear in）”的地方。
获胜学生的作品最终会刊登在学校的 magazine（杂志）上。
After the exhibition, we could put on a dinner.
听到 special lunch 或 afternoon tea 时要注意，这些都被 John 否定了，他认为傍晚举办更合适并最终选定了 dinner。
画展结束后，学校将组织一场 dinner（晚宴）招待家长。
